readings.source_reading: Parts of N. thrice ; V. complete ; S. ⟦wanting⟧ [wanting above]   n.d: 34 : 15 : D
readings.evidence: The line is indented under f.30 on its own ruled line. It has no shelfmark in the left column and carries its own figures. The next line, d.435(1), repeats n.d:34:15:D and reads 'S. & N.'. That content differs from 'S. wanting'. Nothing on the page shows which shelfmark the line belongs to.

The shelfmark is written smaller and more loosely than its neighbours, with a trailing stroke after '(7'. A faint horizontal stroke may cross it, but the stroke could equally be pen drag or overwriting. A deliberate strike-through cannot be confirmed.
The final digit has a hooked, angular form. It is unlike the plain '1' of d.451(1), (2) and (4), and also unlike the clear '7' of d.437(4). It may be an altered digit.
The third character is a narrow stroke with a small curl and looks closer to '1' than to this hand's usual '5'. However, the ink is faint and the 'D' is also faint. The reading is not secure.
No macrons are visible over 'Raghavana' and no letters follow it before 'Pandita'. A dot appears under the 'Pandita' area. The completion '[nda?]' is not supported by the source.

readings.source_reading: [curved line with arrowhead at top near c.242(1); lower end with arrowhead pointing at '+334(1)']
readings.evidence: The ink curve runs down the left margin past the Aufrecht note and ends in an arrowhead at +334(1). It carries no wording, so its purpose cannot be determined.
The small cramped hand at the top right fits 'Dev…bhāgavata', but the vowel marks are not individually clear.
The line-count figure is overwritten and has a long descending tail. The underlying digit is not legible.
The final pencil digit is q-shaped with a tail, matching this hand's '9' (compare '1799'). It remains faint.
The word 'by' is clearly written between 'D:' and the underlined title, and again before 'Dhanapatisūri'.
